# Introduction

A Yuleklapp is a seasonal buildable structure which has item slots, for storing items inside. It needs to be built within the range of a Workbench.
It comes in small, medium and large variants with 1, 2 and 3 slots, respectively.

## Availability

Yuleklapp cannot be built year-round. It can only be built during the Christmas season, 1 December – 6 January.

Categorias: Furniture, Seasonal Furniture, Storage
